title: Billing Transaction Receive Command
description: Imperative request, from a Mercury transaction webhook, that the billing authority read AAI's Mercury account into its cash book now (Milkshake Story 9.6). farm-command-bridge accepts Mercury's delivery at POST /v1/mercury-webhooks on mercury-hooks.delo.sh, verifies Mercury-Signature over the raw body, archives the body as evidence and publishes this minimal request signed with its own mercury-hook-* key: ids, types and instants only, never an amount or a name. One command per Mercury event (command_id = uuid5(NS_MERCURY_HOOK, 'event:' + event_id)). milkshake-farm-consumer (durable milkshake-mercury-hook) re-verifies the signature and the registered endpoint, coalesces deliveries into one ms tx sync and answers with billing.transaction.recorded, .denied or .failed carrying this command_id. idempotency_key: 'billing.transaction.receive:mercury_event:<event_id>:command:<command_id>'. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md (billing, transaction) and Milkshake docs/farm-commands.md section 16.

body_sha256.description: sha256 of canonical(request), the bytes the signature covers.
